name: Szentendre (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Szentendre (a blue shield with a white lamb within a yellow baroque frame) above the name SZENTENDRE in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szentendre arms in a yellow frame
